stages.name: dead_traits
stages.query:
SELECT d.*,rx_replace(d.name,'_(?:async|lazy)$','') AS base_name,CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE module || '::' || class_name END AS class_id,
 CASE WHEN kind='class' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ABC')>0)
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'abstractmethod$')) END AS abstract,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$')) AS property,
 rx_matches(name,'^__.*__$') OR name IN ('main','pytest_configure','pytest_collection_modifyitems') OR
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'validator$|overload$')) AS implicit,
 rx_matches(name,'Protocol$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS protocol,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS structural_protocol
 FROM proj_declarations d

stages.name: class_names
stages.query:
SELECT r.module,r.name,coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_imports i JOIN proj_resolved_names n ON n.fqname=i.target JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=n.symbol AND c.kind='class' WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=r.module AND i.name=r.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.module=r.module AND c.name=r.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1)) AS target
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.module,a.name FROM proj_annotation_names a JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol) r

stages.name: module_names
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module,n.name FROM raw_module_names n
 WHERE n.control IS NOT NULL OR n.nested_class IS NOT NULL OR (
 (n.decorated_function IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start=n.decorated_function AND f.class_name IS NOT NULL))
 AND (n.decorated_class IS NULL OR n.class_body IS NOT NULL)
 AND (n.class IS NULL OR n.class_body IS NOT NULL)
 AND (n.function IS NULL OR (n.default_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start=n.function AND f.class_name IS NOT NULL))))

stages.name: imported_modules
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE modules(module) AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN kind='module' THEN target ELSE rx_replace(target,'\.?[^.]+$','') END FROM proj_imports
 UNION SELECT rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') FROM modules WHERE instr(module,'.')>0)
 SELECT DISTINCT module FROM modules WHERE module<>''

cases.true: SELECT symbol FROM proj_exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM proj_public_methods p JOIN proj_exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM imported_modules
cases.false: SELECT symbol FROM proj_exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM proj_public_methods p JOIN proj_exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM imported_modules UNION SELECT n.symbol FROM raw_dynamic_imports d JOIN proj_resolved_names n ON n.fqname=rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',1) || '.' || rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',2)

stages.name: reach_edges
stages.query:
SELECT s.id AS source,t.id AS target FROM reference_edges e
 JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.__path=e.__path AND s.__start=e.__start JOIN proj_declarations t ON t.__path=e.target_path AND t.__start=e.target_start
 UNION SELECT owner,symbol FROM proj_public_methods
 UNION SELECT h.owner,m.id FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN proj_declarations m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name
 WHERE m.name IN ('__new__','__init__','__init_subclass__','__post_init__','__set_name__','__class_getitem__')
 UNION SELECT owner,base FROM proj_base_edges UNION SELECT base,owner FROM proj_base_edges
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dead_traits d CROSS JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.module=d.module
 AND s.name IN (d.base_name,d.base_name || '_async',d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='function'
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dead_traits d CROSS JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.id IN
 (d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name,d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_async',d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT a.symbol,c.target FROM proj_annotation_names a JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol JOIN class_names c ON c.module=d.module AND c.name=a.name WHERE c.target IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT d.id,'@module:' || d.module FROM proj_declarations d
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM module_names n JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.module=n.module AND d.name=n.name
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM module_names n JOIN proj_imports i ON i.module=n.module AND i.name=n.name AND i.kind='symbol' JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.fqname=i.target
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_declarations local WHERE local.module=n.module AND local.name=n.name)
 UNION SELECT m.id,other.id FROM dead_traits m JOIN dead_traits c ON c.id=m.class_id AND c.structural_protocol
 JOIN dead_traits other ON other.kind='method' AND other.name=m.name AND other.class_id<>m.class_id

stages.name: reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE flow(node,dispatch) AS (
 SELECT symbol,NULL FROM dead_roots
 UNION SELECT e.target,NULL FROM flow f JOIN reach_edges e ON e.source=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.node FROM flow f JOIN dead_traits m ON m.id=f.node JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.base=m.class_id WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL AND m.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.base=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT b.base,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.owner=f.node JOIN dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL AND b.base<>original.class_id
 UNION SELECT m.id,NULL FROM flow f JOIN dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=f.node JOIN dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=original.name WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT DISTINCT node AS symbol FROM flow WHERE dispatch IS NULL

stages.name: annotation_reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE unique_classes(name,target) AS (SELECT name,min(id) FROM proj_declarations WHERE kind='class' GROUP BY name HAVING count(*)=1),
 annotated(symbol) AS (SELECT symbol FROM reachable UNION SELECT c.target FROM annotated r JOIN proj_annotation_names a ON a.symbol=r.symbol JOIN unique_classes c ON c.name=a.name)
 SELECT symbol FROM annotated

stages.name: high_confidence
stages.query:
SELECT d.* FROM dead_traits d
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_reachable r WHERE r.symbol=d.id)
 AND NOT rx_matches(d.module,'^(?:api|data_layer)\.') AND NOT d.implicit
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_imports i WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.target=d.fqname)
 AND NOT (d.kind='class' AND d.protocol)
 AND NOT (d.kind<>'class' AND (d.abstract OR d.property OR instr(d.name,'_lower_')=1 OR instr(lower(d.name),'register')>0
   OR rx_matches(d.name,'^_create_.*_(?:connection|validator|factory)$')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dead_traits c WHERE c.id=d.class_id AND c.protocol)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN dead_traits c ON c.id=h.base JOIN dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=d.name AND m.abstract WHERE h.owner=d.class_id AND h.depth>0)))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN dead_traits b ON b.id=h.base JOIN annotation_reachable r ON r.symbol=b.id
   WHERE h.owner=CASE WHEN d.kind='class' THEN d.id ELSE d.class_id END AND h.depth>0 AND
   (b.abstract OR (instr(b.name,'ABC')>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_base_edges e WHERE e.owner=h.owner AND e.base=b.id))))

cases.true:
SELECT __path AS path,__start AS start_byte,__end AS end_byte,id AS symbol,category FROM (SELECT d.*, 'high_confidence_functions' AS category FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind<>'class'
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_intents' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_grammar_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_other_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND NOT (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0)) AND NOT (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar')))))
